uv run pytest tests/test_stripe tests/test_urls.py tests/test_app.py

deviations.what: The Stripe app's docs are three pages, docs/how-to/install-the-stripe-app.md, docs/how-to/point-stripe-at-the-webhook.md and docs/reference/stripe-app.md, instead of the single docs/stripe.md the plan names.
deviations.why: The conformance gate refuses a docs page outside tutorial, how-to/, reference/ or explanation/. Later stories should extend the reference page.
deviations.decision_ref: none: layout forced by the conformance gate

deviations.what: The fake's own tests live in tests/test_stripe/test_client.py (TestFakeStripe, TestSignWebhook) instead of tests/test_stripe_fake.py.
deviations.why: The conformance mirror rule refused a test module with no source module to mirror.
deviations.decision_ref: none: forced by the conformance gate

deviations.what: Customer.from_checkout also refuses and logs a session whose customer id is already recorded for a different user.
deviations.why: Creating it would hit the unique stripe_id constraint and make the webhook fail on every Stripe retry; FR-007 says a customer that cannot be tied to the user is recorded against nobody.

deviations.what: views.webhook runs its handling inside transaction.atomic, and answers 500 without verifying anything when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset or empty.
deviations.why: A checkout that fails after the customer row is created would otherwise leave a half-recorded customer, and an empty HMAC key lets anyone forge a signature.
ARCH-003 was real: with it, mypy reported mvp_payments/stripe as a second copy of the top-level module stripe and stopped. mypy now resolves import stripe to the SDK.

deviations.what: client.py holds a private module-level _http_client that the stripe_fake fixture sets, and client() takes no argument.
deviations.why: The app's own code builds its client in several places, so the seam has to be on the module, not a parameter.

concerns: SQLite has no row locks, so the suite cannot show that Customer.sync() emits SELECT ... FOR UPDATE. A test asserts the customer SELECT is the first statement in the transaction, and the lock is by construction. A PostgreSQL run would prove it.
A subscription Stripe returns with no items would raise KeyError in Customer.sync() and answer the webhook 500 on every retry. Stripe does not return one, so no handling was added.
specs/004-stripe-app/US1-brief.json was untracked when the story started and is committed with the report.
tasks.md still names docs/stripe.md for later stories (T008-T012); it should now read docs/reference/stripe-app.md, and the how-to pages if they gain steps.
demo/.env.example gains STRIPE_TEST_WEBHOOK_SECRET; the README's demo section and stripe listen docs are left to US5 as the brief says.
